verdict_K: PROVISIONALLY NOT FOUND IN PRINT (novel as a combined statement). No source found that gives finite-sample, scale-free critical values or certified worst-case coverage for the Student/finite-population t interval uniformly over a class bounding max|x-mean|/SD (or max share of sum of squares), under SRSWOR or iid, with two-/few-point extremals. Nearest results, each missing the core: (a) Lehmann & Loh 1990, Chen & Loh 1990, Romano 2004: asymptotic uniform validity of the t-test over bounded-standardized-moment / uniform-integrability classes, no finite-sample critical values or extremal laws (closeness 3, same class idea, asymptotic only); (b) Pinelis 2006 (arXiv math/0606160) plus Efron 1969 / Eaton / Pinelis 1994 / Pinelis 2015 (arXiv 1204.1761): two-point mixture decomposition and sharp self-normalized tail bounds under symmetry or an asymmetry-corrected statistic, independent summands, no finite population and no max-share class (closeness 2); (c) Edelman 2025 (arXiv 2508.13226) claims k-sparse equal-weight extremals for weighted Rademacher sums but its main theorem is refuted by Pinelis (arXiv 2509.02410), and it is symmetric-only; (d) Hendriks-IJzerman-Boon-Klaassen 2006: extremal uniform parent in the symmetric unimodal iid class; (e) Bloznelis 1999, Hu-Robinson-Wang 2007, Sugden-Smith-Jones 2000: Berry-Esseen / Cramer-type / Edgeworth for finite-population Student t, asymptotic or non-sharp constants, not exact critical values. WoR betting/Serfling/Bardenet-Maillard need known bounded range. Caveats: Edelman 1990, Efron 1969, Hajek 1960, Gleser-Hwang 1987, Dufour 1997, Phan-Thomas-Ramdas, Shekhar-Ramdas, Szekely 2006 were checked only via citations/background knowledge, not read; Semantic Scholar returned 429 so no citation-graph check; arXiv keyword search was poor (many irrelevant hits); paywalled journal papers (Lehmann-Loh, Romano 2004, Chen-Loh, Hendriks et al.) were seen via abstracts only, so a finite-sample corollary hidden in their bodies cannot be excluded (Lehmann-Loh most likely place to look).
verdict_K2: PROVISIONALLY NOT FOUND (novel as stated). No source found giving exact/certified finite-sample self-normalized bounds for stratified or cluster sums with many independent strata under a max-share or bounded-standardized-deviation class. Adjacent but different: Bakirov-Szekely 2006 and Ibragimov-Muller 2010/2016 (t-test on few heterogeneous clusters, Gaussian, conservative for small alpha), Potscher-Preinerstorfer arXiv 2412.17470 (Gaussian linear model size control), Qing-Valliant 2025 (Edgeworth minimum n per stratum, asymptotic), arXiv 2503.13986 (stratified permutational Berry-Esseen, asymptotic). Fewer sources searched for K2 than for K (about 4 targeted queries), so K2 confidence is lower.
